name: cache-statusband
description: Nate Herk's Cache Keeper plus a ccstatusline-style status band: model, effort, context, cache, 5-hour/weekly/Fable usage with resets, and reopened chats measured before you send

author.name: Hameishiv, built on Cache Keeper by Nate Herk

seatFileTerminal.title: Seat file (terminal)
seatFileTerminal.description: For account rotators: a file holding the active seat's label (e.g. ~/.claude-cli-accounts/.active). Read when a session starts: the band shows that label in place of the account email. A running session keeps its account, so a change counts only once the rotator's wake-up prompt (below) reaches it, or within 3 minutes after it. Leave empty to show the account email.

seatFileDesktop.title: Seat file (desktop app)
seatFileDesktop.description: The same for sessions the desktop app runs, so each seat keeps its own usage reading. The app's band doesn't show it. Leave empty to turn off.

rotatorWakePattern.title: Rotator wake-up pattern
rotatorWakePattern.description: A regular expression matching the prompt an unattended account rotator types after rotating. Such a prompt is compacted first without asking, since nobody is there to answer. For 3 minutes after it, a late rewrite of the seat file or the account is still taken as that rotation. Leave empty to turn off.

prPattern.title: PR session pattern
prPattern.description: A regular expression whose first group is a PR number, matched against any prompt while the session has no PR tracked, and against a resumed session's transcript (e.g. (?:^|\s)/?merge-pr\s+#?(\d+)). Keep warm then stops once gh reports that PR merged or closed. Leave empty to turn off.

autoResume.title: Auto-resume after usage renews
autoResume.description: When a chat's turn is cut short because the plan's usage ran out, send it "Resume" a minute after the full window resets. Spends usage without asking, so it is off by default. A big chat is compacted first. With no known reset time it tries hourly, three times at most. A resume armed from a full window is tried a minute after the account changes instead of at that window's reset, since the window was the old account's, and a failure from a request still out when the account changes is retried a minute later without counting as a try. The request a message you send starts settles it; /clear and resuming another chat cancel it, and a branch does not (it carries the conversation on, so a pending Resume, or one compacting, goes on in the branch). While the Resume compacts, a message that reaches the chat (another plugin's too), /clear or resuming another chat cancels it; a local command (a typed /branch too; not /plan with a description, which goes to the model unless the chat is already in plan mode, where it only shows the plan: a mod is not told the mode), a branch, or a message another hook drops does not. A rotator wake-up arriving cancels it too, and waits for the compaction already running, using it if it succeeds. A wake-up that is itself cancelled arms no Resume in its place. A cold-send dialog open for a message of yours holds it until it closes: Cancel lets it go, Send anyway or Compact first cancels it (a /btw question does not: it never reaches the chat). With no request starting within 2 minutes, a cancelled Resume is armed again then (the band shows it meanwhile), and if its compaction succeeded it goes without compacting again. If its compaction failed and you answered Cancel on a cold-send dialog while it compacted, it is armed again the same way rather than sent uncompacted; if that compaction fails too, it is not sent and a toast says to send Resume yourself. A compaction still running after 15 minutes is abandoned, but it may still finish: until it does, no send starts another. The Resume is not sent uncompacted and is tried again 2 minutes later without starting another compaction while the abandoned one is still out, as a counted try (the last toast names the cause of the last failed try: a send refused, or compaction not finished). A message or wake-up that started it or waited on it goes back in the prompt box together, in the order sent, as one text (a slash command is quoted in a toast instead, never joined), and a message put back while that text is still unsent goes in behind it when it does not come from the prompt box (a remote or bridge send, such as a wake-up delivered remotely; one you send from the prompt box takes the box's text with it), and text the mod did not put there is never rewritten: the box is read when the engine allows, and if it is empty or holds exactly what was last put back (a trailing newline or CRLF line ends do not count) the new text is added behind it, while anything else (a draft you are typing, your edit of the put-back) is left as it is and each message is quoted in full in a toast instead, which holds a due Resume just as a put-back does; a read not answered within 2 seconds, or that fails, leaves the box alone and quotes the message the same way (the remembered text is not used then, and a read showing the box empty ends it); the unsent put-back text is remembered until a message is sent, a request starts or the chat is cleared or another is resumed (a branch keeps it, unless you typed it as a command: anything you submit from the prompt box, /branch included, takes the text in the box and ends it, and the Resume hold too when the message was put back in the box, but not when it was only quoted in a toast), and it is used in place of a read only when the engine cannot read the box; a fill not answered within 2 seconds may still land: the toast says the message "may not have been put back" (after a compaction that finished: "Compacted, but the message may not have been sent again"; after one that failed: "The message may not have been sent again"), the box counts as unknown, and the message holds a due Resume as a put-back does; while that fill is still out (until it answers or fails, 15 minutes at most for one that never does; across a /clear or resume too) a put-back quotes its message and leaves the box alone; a late answer that did not fill may be only the engine giving up (its own timeout is 5 seconds per client), so it ends the Resume wait for that message only if the box, read afterwards, shows the text is not in it (only the wait that fill started: a message quoted in a toast earlier keeps holding, and so does an earlier put-back still shown in the box that the fill was joined behind; with no way to read the box, a late answer that did not fill makes the earlier put-back's text the remembered text again, as a best effort: the box most likely still starts with it, and if the engine writes the joined text after all, the next put-back may replace the newer part, and it is not remembered again if you submitted from the prompt box, a message was handed on or a request started meanwhile, or another put-back was started since; one that filled makes the text it filled, joined or not, the remembered one unless you submitted from the prompt box, a message was handed on or a request started meanwhile, or another put-back was started since), and a fill that lands after you submitted from the prompt box starts the wait again, remembering the text when a read of the box shows it there (with no way to read, or a read that fails or does not answer, the wait starts but nothing is remembered; only a read that works and does not show the text starts nothing); after it has answered (or 15 minutes) a put-back on an engine that can read the box reads it and leaves it alone unless it is empty (with no way to read the box, nothing remembered, it is overwritten). A slash command is never joined and is quoted in full in a toast instead (when the box holds one this mod put back and plain text is put back, the text is filled and the command quoted), and the cold-send dialog then offers only Send anyway and Cancel. A pending Resume waits until you send what was put back, clear the chat, submit a command or other text from the prompt box over a message that was put back in it (a message only quoted in the toast was never in the box, so it keeps holding, also when another message was put back in the box after it), or 15 minutes pass (the band shows "Resume waits for your message"); a message that could not be put back, or a /btw question, holds nothing and ends nothing (an earlier message's wait stays). If it finishes later and succeeded, later sends go without compacting again; any later successful compaction (not one that started before a newer abandoned one, nor an engine compaction notice while an older compaction of this mod is still out and started under 30 minutes ago), or a second 15 minutes, forgets it, and one from a chat since cleared or replaced is ignored: its message is not sent into the new chat (a toast says why, quoting it in full, or, for a chat cleared while the message is being put back, "The chat was cleared while your message was being put back: <text>"; a branch carries the conversation on, so its message is sent, and a compaction in flight at the branch stays that conversation's) and is dropped when that compaction ends, a send there does not wait on it, and the engine's compaction notices are ignored while it is out, for up to 30 minutes. A Resume that cannot be sent, directly or after compacting, is tried again 2 minutes later, four attempts in all, unless a request or /clear settles it meanwhile. A due resume waits while the cold-send dialog is open, any send handed on that is not this mod's own is being handed on, compacting or has not yet started its request (at most 2 minutes), or a rotator wake-up's request has not started.
